chunks: And those who denied Our signs and the meeting in the Hereafter, their deeds have become void; are they to be rewarded except for what they used to do?
ai.seo_question: What happens to the deeds of those who deny the Hereafter?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-A'raf elucidates the concept of 'habitat al-a'mal' (nullification of deeds), where the rejection of divine signs and the afterlife corrupts the foundation of otherwise valid good works. It underscores that ultimate acceptance depends on sincere belief (iman) and awareness of the Hereafter, rather than mere ritual action. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the unity of belief and action, where denial renders even righteous deeds void in the sight of God.
